name: Credential & Badge Observation
description: Visual capture of badge designs, access control hardware, and employee credential presentation behaviors during recon feeds directly into badge fabrication and impersonation. Key details to document include badge orientation, logo placement, color coding by department or clearance level, holographic elements, clip or lanyard type, and whether employees present badges to readers or use proximity. This documentation drives the social engineering and badge fabrication phases.

blue.det: Individual observing or photographing badge readers and access hardware; camera aimed at entry points during badge use.
blue.cm: Camera covers or shields on readers; awareness training on credential handling; anti-skimming covers; employees aware not to display badge faces unnecessarily.
